ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels concentrated in the central lobe regions vs 35% low-intensity black pixels concentrated along the trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, contiguous white fields dominate the center of both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a thick, irregular border along the superior trailing edges. Two isolated, dark, elongated elliptical spots are located in the lower-inner quadrant of the left lobe's white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency and high-amplitude serrations are visible across the entire trailing edge. The left lobe contains several deep, irregular V-shaped valleys, while the right lobe shows a more consistent but jagged 'saw-tooth' profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Superior boundaries of both lobes exhibit a convex curve tapering towards the tips; the complete trajectory is interrupted by water occlusion at the peduncle connection.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, dark, mottled pixel clusters are visible along the interface of the white and black regions on the inner margins of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct, dark, sub-parallel linear pixel disruptions are visible on the white ventral surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss or deep indentation on the superior trailing edge of the left lobe. Dark linear marks on the left lobe are indicative of healed abrasions.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetrical encroachment of black pigmentation from the trailing edge into the white field, notably more pronounced and irregular on the left lobe.
